name: Trishna Basak

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Trishna Basak is a Bengali poet, fiction writer and translator from Kolkata. Trained in engineering at Jadavpur University, she went on to make literature her principal work. Her publisher's biography describes a practice spanning poetry, novels, science fiction and essays, alongside translation and editing. Unborn — Selected Poems brings a selection of her poetry into English in Nandita Samanta's translation.

Mahanirvana, presented here in Bappaditya Roy Biswas's English translation, imagines the Buddha's final conversations through hunger, memory, tenderness and physical frailty. Sacred figures speak with an intimacy that unsettles a purely ceremonial account of death. Its movement between the body and the injunction to become one's own light gives philosophical reflection a startlingly human voice.
